annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates the count of different types across two model categories labeled "GPT3.5" and "Mistral 7B". The horizontal axis represents the model categories, labeled accordingly from left to right, while the vertical axis indicates the count, marked with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 120 with tick intervals of 20. Each model category contains grouped bars representing five types, distinguished by color: Type1 in teal, Type2 in orange, Type3 in greyish blue, RR in pink, and WW in green. For the "GPT3.5" model, the approximate values are Type1 at 15, Type2 at 25, RR as the tallest at 120, and WW at 35. For the "Mistral 7B" model, Type1 and Type2 are approximately equal at 30 and 20, respectively, with RR again the tallest at around 110, and WW at 30. The bars within each group are arranged consistently, and the heights of the RR bars are notably higher than other types in both models. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and there is no visual emphasis, such as bolding or outlining, present. There is a legend on the top left of the chart to infer bars with their colors.
